scope: Bounded documentary consistency review of the qualification summary and current LOT8A integration roadmap block; prior detailed evidence reviews are reused without repeating capture or native hashing.

findings.detail: 145 files and 5,606 passed tests remain inherited evidence for the unchanged freeze. The closure does not claim a fresh full suite. Entry coverage 67/76 (88.2%), 209 component-verified modules, 147 partial and 1,013 pending are separate populations; all six complete-migration gates remain false.
Binding 6,818/6,818, Motif 20/20 and SelectedRigid 56 events, 22 ablations and 7 action-changing ablations agree with reviewed evidence and are not added to the 5,606-test population.

11 cases and 187 checks are reconciled from ten successful series-02 cases plus WEAV-03. Failed series 02 remains 10/11 and 170/187. WEAV 81 actions, 81 prefixes and 3 levels is a functional recovery; 1,536 MiB is the Node old-space budget, not an RSS ceiling or an official cost result.

findings.topic: Prepared work forms and graph qualification
findings.detail: Four sessions and 31 actions per role give eight sessions and 62 actions. The 64 reader checks, 58 paired graph points, 116 role observations, 168 trace-clock bounds and 290 checkpoint coverage entries remain distinct. All 21,956 recorded differences are retained: 20,893 source digests, 1,055 exact created timestamp occurrences and eight Motif node additions; zero are unattributed.

The prepared parent is not actual published 0.64. preparedOnly=true, officialPerformanceEligible=false and strictCommonGraphParity=false remain explicit. No official cost session, final publication, full original caller parity or general three-active-owner episode proof is asserted.

The prospective protocol has 40 ABBA trials: 32 measured sessions/400 actions and eight excluded warmups/24 actions. Each game must independently stay strictly below +10% in complete-session median duration; phase overruns may be accepted if both global criteria pass, with all samples and diagnostics retained.

Ordinary work proceeds in the dedicated checkout and branch without a global lock or waiting for other publications. 8B remains source preparation only, with its transfer contract and independent component corpus next. Final 8A release still requires the actual 0.63/0.64 lineage, affected final qualification, official cost acceptance and private publication under short exclusivity.
The roadmap now says JSON matérialisé après l’échec du premier inventaire, accurately describing the retained terminal missing-module failure rather than an interrupted process.
